**Empty list items in markdown renderer cause IndexError**

**Describe the bug**
When rendering markdown lists that contain empty items, the renderer crashes with an IndexError.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
```
$ git clone https://github.com/lepture/mistune.git
$ cd mistune
$ python -c "import mistune; print(mistune.markdown('- \n- item'))"
```

This will raise an IndexError because the first list item is empty.

**Expected behavior**
The renderer should handle empty list items gracefully without crashing.

**Your project**
https://github.com/lepture/mistune/blob/master/src/mistune/renderers/_list.py#L43

**Environment info**
- OS: Linux
- Python version: 3.10
- Mistune version: latest from master

**Additional context**
This issue occurs when a markdown list contains an empty item. For example:

```markdown
- 
- Second item
```

The first item is empty, which causes the renderer to crash when trying to access the first element of an empty list.

Scope of this editing session: update the following production files and submit the resulting local patch: src/mistune/renderers/_list.py. No full task validation has been performed in this session.
